subject: Social Media
title: Creator Burnout
description: A quick win: understand Creator Burnout.

hook.text: A top YouTuber posts a video titled 'Why I'm Taking a Break.' Millions watch. The cycle continues.

buildup.text: Algorithms punish inconsistency. Miss a week and your reach drops. The content treadmill never stops.

discovery.text: A 2022 survey found 90% of creators report burnout. The pressure to perform daily is relentless.

twist.text: Taking breaks hurts algorithmically. Creators return to smaller audiences. The platform forgets fast.

climax.text: Some hire teams to maintain the treadmill. The hobby that freed them now requires employees.

punchline.text: The algorithm doesn't care if you're tired.

quiz.question: Why do creators struggle to take breaks?
options: Algorithms punish inconsistency with reduced reach
